name: Arbúcies (Spain)
description: Divided by a broad white diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, blue above and green below, charged at the centre with a green sprig with red berries.
history: Municipal flag of Arbúcies; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
sprig of strawberry tree with red berries
